sources: docker cp (stdout only): stopped private DB PG_VERSION exists and contains 16

api.interpretation: The helper invokes Alembic upgrade head on every API startup. At existing current head this is expected to be a no-op, but it must not be represented as a command path without bootstrap/migration. If version metadata is absent, it creates schema and stamps 0067 before real upgrade0068. This audit did not execute that command.

db.interpretation: Existing PostgreSQL16 cluster marker is present on the named volume. Starting this exact existing DB should reopen that cluster (including ordinary PostgreSQL recovery/housekeeping), not run initial schema/business seeding. Current business records remain unverified while it is stopped.

redis.interpretation: No persistence or business bootstrap configured. Redis is not required for direct read-only PostgreSQL observations.

smallest_runtime_verification_option: Root may separately choose controlled startup of only the exact existing private DB, then execute BEGIN READ ONLY selected identity/head/hash queries and ROLLBACK. API/Redis startup is not necessary for that observation. This audit neither authorizes nor performs a new lifecycle, schema repair, restore, or API bootstrap.
